description:
Overview

Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes. Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, design, and drive intelligent automation solutions to develop and implement strategies for supply chain cost reduction and efficiency.
  • Leverage automated solutions to optimize the review of purchased services, clinical supplies, and GPO contracts.
  • Collaborate with clinical teams to streamline procurement of clinical supplies and physician preference items using technology.
  • Participate in the development and implementation of intelligent automation tools to drive best practices in inventory management.
  • Assist in developing proposals and presentations for potential clients, highlighting technological efficiencies.
  • Build relationships with internal and external stakeholders, focusing on technology-driven initiatives.
  • Communicate progress and outcomes of supply chain improvements to executive leadership.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to achieve organizational goals through innovative solutions.
  • Identify and implement intelligent automation opportunities to streamline internal supply chain methodologies with a focus on improving quality and reducing the cost to deliver.
  • Identify third-party solutions and relationships to accelerate supply chain intelligent automation through partnerships and potential acquisitions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in healthcare supply chain management and consulting.
  • Proven track record of designing supply chain intelligent automation solutions to achieve cost reductions and process improvements.
  • Strong knowledge of GPOs, clinical supplies, physician preference items, and purchased/support services.
  • Experience with current and evolving inventory management systems and automation technologies within the healthcare and supply chain industries.
  • Experience with developing automated or AI solutions to meet internal or client needs; Data Science or Engineering experience preferred.
  • Experience with Large Language Models and their use in the healthcare industry.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Compensation

The estimated base salary range for this job is $215,000 - $265,000. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay-for-performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $268,750 - $350,750. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. Vem ser Odontocliniquer e crescer com a gente!

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos.

Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que não apenas vestem a camisa, mas têm atitude de dono, colocam a mão na massa e fazem acontecer todos os dias.

Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento.

Na Odontoclinic, você encontra um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e cheio de oportunidades. Um lugar onde você pode ser quem é, crescer, aprender e deixar sua marca. Se você tem espírito empreendedor, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de algo grande, seu lugar é aqui.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Overview

Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect

Location: Brazil / Argentina (Remote)

Long term contract

Job Summary

We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role will interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber / Privacy / Legal teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Key Qualifications and Experiences

Technical Expertise :

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI / CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI / CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP / REST) and API development.
  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.

Specialized Skills :

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.

Soft Skills and Others :

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.

Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.

How your day will look like / Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends

Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships

Knowledge

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors

Skills

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)

Attitude

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Seo Strategist / Head Of Seo
description:
Overview


We are seeking a highly skilled and visionary SEO Strategist / Head of SEO to define and lead our search growth roadmap. In this senior role, you will be responsible for setting the overall SEO direction, prioritizing initiatives that drive business impact, and aligning organic growth efforts with company-wide objectives.


As a T-shaped marketer, you will combine deep SEO expertise with a broad understanding of marketing, analytics, and digital growth. You will work closely with leadership, product, design, content, and development teams to ensure SEO is embedded across every function of the business. The ideal candidate is both analytical and creative, capable of developing data-driven strategies while inspiring cross-functional teams to execute at the highest level.



Responsibilities



  • Strategy & Leadership

    • Define the organization’s SEO vision, long-term growth roadmap, and execution strategy.

    • Design and implement comprehensive SEO initiatives across technical SEO, content strategy, link-building, and experimentation.

    • Evaluate and prioritize opportunities based on ROI, complexity, and competitive landscape.

    • Align SEO objectives with overarching business KPIs, including marketing qualified leads (MQLs), customer acquisition cost (CAC), annual recurring revenue (ARR), and pipeline velocity.

    • Continuously monitor search engine trends, algorithm updates, and industry best practices to maintain a competitive advantage.

    • Champion SEO within the organization, ensuring buy-in from stakeholders and visibility at the leadership level.



  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Partner with product and development teams to ensure SEO requirements are factored into platform architecture, site migrations, and new feature rollouts.

    • Work with content and editorial teams to build a scalable framework for keyword-driven, high-performing content.

    • Collaborate with design and UX / UI teams to ensure website changes and new templates support both usability and SEO performance.

    • Align closely with marketing and demand generation teams to integrate SEO into campaigns, events, and broader growth initiatives.

    • Build strong relationships across departments to foster a culture where SEO is considered a critical growth lever, not a siloed function.



  • Performance Tracking & Reporting

    • Establish a robust measurement framework for SEO, defining clear KPIs and success benchmarks.

    • Use analytics tools (GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Looker Studio) to monitor performance, identify opportunities, and track progress.

    • Deliver detailed reporting to leadership on keyword growth, traffic trends, conversion impact, and revenue attribution from SEO.

    • Translate complex SEO data into actionable insights and recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.

    • Identify gaps in analytics or reporting and collaborate with data teams to enhance measurement accuracy.



  • Team & Vendor Management

    • Build and lead an SEO team (in-house or distributed), ensuring a balance of technical expertise, content strategy, and off-page authority building.

    • Manage external SEO agencies, freelancers, or consultants, ensuring alignment with internal goals and quality standards.

    • Mentor and upskill team members across departments, fostering greater SEO literacy throughout the organization.





Qualifications



  • Must-Haves

    • 4+ years of proven SEO strategy and leadership experience, ideally in a tech-driven environment.

    • Demonstrated track record of scaling organic channels to deliver measurable business results (e.g., revenue growth, lead generation, or market expansion).

    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and make data-driven decisions.

    • Proficiency in SEO and analytics platforms, including GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, and Looker Studio.

    • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence executives and cross-functional peers.

    • Deep understanding of how SEO intersects with broader marketing, product, and sales strategies.



  • Nice-to-Haves

    • Experience managing SEO at scale for international or enterprise-level websites.

    • Familiarity with CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization), paid media, and marketing automation tools.

    • Hands-on experience with technical SEO concepts such as schema markup, JavaScript rendering, and Core Web Vitals.

    • Background in leading distributed teams or managing agency partnerships.





Why Join Us?


This is a rare opportunity to take ownership of a mission-critical growth channel at a pivotal stage in our company’s expansion. As Head of SEO, you will shape not only our search performance but also how SEO informs and strengthens the broader go-to-market strategy. You will be empowered to make high-level decisions, experiment with innovative approaches, and directly impact the scalability of our business.

description:
Overview

Brass Tacks Health (BTH) is a boutique consultancy that specializes in competitive readiness planning. Our mission is to guide our thought partners in building and maintaining a holistic understanding of competitive landscapes in real time, so they can navigate strategic decisions with confidence. Our core competencies are customized deep-dives, continuous competitive monitoring, new product planning support and scenario-planning workshops. We curate what our clients need to know into meaningful, customized narratives. What sets us apart is our track record of enduring partnerships, our time-tested internal processes and our methods of blending ethical intelligence gathering and concise storytelling to deliver reports that are clear, accurate and ready for internal-decision making. We are passionate about enabling our clients to thrive in highly competitive environments while keeping their strategies grounded to what matters most to physicians and patients.

Our greatest asset is our people.

The successful candidate for this role will speak Portuguese, and bring a growth mindset. This means excellent attention to detail, above-ordinary writing skills, and the ability to recognize trends, think strategically, correctly prioritize workflows and take initiative.

The majority of our team are based in Seattle, WA. However, this role is remote.

Note: Only candidates with fluency in Portuguese will be considered.

Responsibilities

  • Be able to efficiently develop and demonstrate a thorough understanding of relevant disease states, competitive landscapes, market dynamics and regulatory and commercialization pathways (global)
  • Conduct desk research and derive meaningful insights
  • Exchange complex medical & scientific information with physicians, scientists and C-suite executives with accuracy and confidence
  • Triangulate across complex data sources to identify trends, and develop defensible takeaways, clearly mapped to primary sources
  • Distill medical and scientific data into insights and actionable reports that are client-ready, and be adept at presenting these directly to clients
  • Continuously monitor emerging data to identify impactful events and client knowledge gaps; review scientific journals, attend scientific and technical meetings
  • Foster and grow projects by always thinking ahead to the next question
  • Take ownership in ensuring that projects are run in a “best-in-class” manner (proactive, communicative, efficient)
  • Follow all external and internal standards to ensure legal and ethical intelligence gathering
  • Mentor and develop other team members
  • Think strategically and take initiative
  • Communicate well

Qualifications

  • Passion for finding and learning complex information quickly
  • Passion for professional growth and efficiency
  • High attention to detail, accuracy and deadlines
  • Comfortable with evolving timelines
  • Proactive
  • Ability to interpret and synthesize scientific data (pre-clinical and clinical) and identify broad implications or specific opportunities
  • Ability to prioritize workflows proactively
  • Ability to communicate complex scientific information effectively and build strong relationships with key stakeholders
  • Comfortable respectfully challenging key decision makers
  • Intellectual agility and resilience
  • Critical thinker
  • PhD in the life sciences with a minimum of 3 to 5 years of professional commercial planning experience, either at a biotech or pharma company or in a previous healthcare-focused consulting capacity
  • Candidates without prior industry experience but with a track record for mastering complex subject matter quickly and excellent writing skills are encouraged to apply

Why Brass Tacks?

Our clients are developing some of the most cutting-edge, clinically-meaningful therapies currently in the clinic for patients with cancer and other disease. We are a small, agile, close-knit team poised for growth. The successful candidate for this position will have the opportunity to make a significant impact, shape their own projects, and build strong relationships with both physician opinion leaders and senior industry management.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

description:
Overview

Job Title : Data Sales Engineer

Pay : 3,000 U$D monthly

Location : Fully remote, Brazil

Long-Term Opportunity with European Company

About Infobel Pro

Infobel Pro is a leading provider of large-scale B2B, Point of Interest (POI), and B2C data. We empower businesses globally with comprehensive, accurate, and actionable data to drive their sales, marketing, and analytical efforts. As we continue to expand, we are looking for a technically adept and commercially-minded Sales Engineer to join our team and serve as a crucial link between our powerful data products and our clients’ business needs.

The Role

As a Data Sales Engineer, you will be a key player in our sales process, acting as the primary technical resource for our sales team and a trusted advisor to our prospective clients. You will be responsible for understanding the complex data challenges of our prospects and demonstrating how Infobel Pro’s solutions can solve them. This role is perfect for someone with a strong technical background, a passion for data, and a consultative, business-oriented mindset.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Pre-Sales Support : Collaborate with the sales team to understand prospect requirements and articulate the technical and business value of our data solutions.
  • Data Sample Preparation : Prepare and deliver custom data samples for prospects, which involves matching tens of thousands of records and requires proficiency in SQL (e.g., using DuckDB) and Python to leverage our internal matching APIs.
  • Product Expertise : Serve as the subject matter expert on Infobel Pro’s data offerings. You will be expected to explain our data products and enrichment processes at a deep technical level to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Solution Design : Work with clients to design and propose data solutions that meet their specific needs, ensuring they derive maximum value from our products.
  • Client Communication : Build strong relationships with prospects by providing expert guidance, answering technical questions, and ensuring a smooth pre-sales experience.

What You Bring

  • A strong technical background, ideally from a STEM field or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis, with experience handling large datasets. Experience with tools like DuckDB is a plus.
  • Good command of Python for scripting, data processing, and interacting with APIs.
  • Good communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • A business-oriented mindset, with the ability to connect technical features to business value. Experience in a client-facing role (e.g., consulting, sales engineering) is highly desirable.
  • A proactive, problem-solving attitude and the ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

What We Offer

  • A growing company with a strong vision
  • Competitive pay
  • Commission structure
  • Supportive team culture focused on learning, ownership, and impact
  • Remote work environment
  • Exposure to global customers and a wide variety of data use cases

Abilities and Other Requirements

In order to successfully perform the essential functions of this job the employee must be able to verbally communicate with employees, co-workers and customers online and by phone.

title: Support Application Specialist
description:
Overview

ParentSquare is a rapidly growing Santa Barbara-based company that changes how schools and parents communicate. Our mission is to empower schools to enhance family engagement for all students. Our flagship products, ParentSquare and RemindHub, serve over 22 million students and provide unified communications tools including forms, sign ups, payments, RSVPs, direct messaging, language translations, chat and more. Remind Chat reaches over 80% of K-12 students with a safe platform for direct teacher-family communication. Our latest innovation, SmartSites, offers state-of-the-art websites for school districts to improve online presence and accessibility.

We are not just creating a product; we are empowering educators and engaging parents to improve the lives of students. We value customers and employees and invite you to join us on this journey.

Who we\'re looking for

A ParentSquare Support Application Specialist is a champion for our customers, with customer service and empathy built into their DNA. You\'ll serve as the point of escalation for the support team and interact with users across email, chat, and phone. You know our product inside and out, solving tickets quickly and efficiently while maintaining a high-quality customer experience. When issues require escalation, you act as the intermediary to ensure no detail is missed.

Beyond direct support, you will strengthen our customer support operations by developing, implementing, and maintaining policies, procedures, and software that empower our teams to deliver consistently excellent service. You\'ll analyze support interaction data to identify opportunities for product improvements and collaborate cross-functionally to elevate the overall customer experience with ParentSquare and Remind. You\'ll validate and manage escalations to ensure timely resolution. Your work directly impacts our ability to grow, continuously improve, and provide the passionate, extra-mile support our customers deserve. Most importantly, you are someone who shares in our passion for improving the lives of students through communication.

This role will include

  • Application & Agent Support
    • Provide Tier 3 agent and application support, including troubleshooting software applications, answering questions, and guiding users to promote efficient use.
    • Resolve support issues quickly and efficiently, clarifying customer needs and identifying best solutions while ensuring a positive experience.
    • Maintain updated knowledge of all company products and services to effectively educate and assist customers.
    • Take detailed notes of customer interactions in the ticketing system to ensure accurate records and follow-up.
    • Escalate tickets to integration services or engineering teams when issues cannot be resolved directly.
  • Incident, Problem & Change Management
    • Identify, record, prioritize, investigate, and resolve incidents and problems to ensure service continuity.
    • Coordinate and document changes or updates to support applications, including planning, testing, and implementation to safeguard functionality and performance.
    • Work closely with engineering to manage SIS migrations and related projects.
  • Release & Process Management
    • Manage product releases, including planning, coordinating, and communicating activities to support teams for smooth transitions.
    • Monitor and maintain support processes, macros, and tools to ensure efficiency and accuracy.
  • Data & Insights
    • Generate reports and analyze data regarding application usage, performance, incidents, and processes to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
    • Collect and record customer feedback, sharing insights with cross-functional teams for continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partner with development, infrastructure, integration services, sales, and security teams, as well as business stakeholders, to meet support application requirements and align solutions with organizational needs.
    • Collaborate with our BPO partner to ensure alignment on support processes, escalations, and service quality, driving consistency across internal and external support teams.

Our ideal candidate will have the following

  • 2-4 years in technical or application support (SaaS/EdTech preferred).
  • Proficiency with ticketing systems (Zendesk ideal) and escalation workflows.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with SIS systems, rostering, or API integrations is a plus.
  • Bachelor\'s degree, or equivalent work experience.

The perks of working for us

We offer strong work-life balance and the following benefits:

  • Employer-paid health insurance (including dependent coverage)
  • Employer-matched 401K retirement savings from day 1
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Stock options
  • Health + wellness reimbursements
  • PTO that increases each year
  • 16 paid holidays, including your birthday

As a fully remote team, we provide the tools and equipment you need for a productive home office.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

The salary range for this role will be approximately $65,000 - $70,000, DOE.

description:
About the Role

We are seeking a motivated and detail oriented Inside Sales Specialist to join our Life Sciences sales team. This role is critical in driving revenue growth across Crown Bioscience's full portfolio of pre-clinical and translational oncology services, including organoids, in vivo and in vitro models, biomarker discovery, human biospecimens, and integrated drug discovery solutions.

The Inside Sales Specialist will develop strong client relationships, manage the inside sales cycle, and support business development initiatives with biotech, pharma, and academic researchers worldwide. By promoting Crown Bioscience's world-leading preclinical platforms, cancer databases, and precision oncology offerings, this role ensures scientists have the tools they need to accelerate discoveries in cancer diagnostics and therapeutics.

Importantly, the Inside Sales Specialist will work with Prendio, a third-party procurement platform for the biotech industry, to help generate biotech leads, manage referrals from their preferred supplier network, and strengthen the partnership relationship.

Key Responsibilities

  • Sales & Business Development
    • Proactively identify, qualify, and manage inbound and outbound sales opportunities across Crown Bioscience's full portfolio (organoids, in vivo/in vitro models, biomarkers, human biospecimens, etc.).
    • Manage the full inside sales cycle: lead generation, prospect engagement, needs assessment, quoting, negotiation, and closing.
    • Collaborate with SDRs and field-based Business Development Directors to support client acquisition, account expansion, and long-term growth.
    • Serve as the primary inside sales contact for Prendio-generated biotech leads.
    • Consistently achieve and exceed assigned sales targets, contributing directly to company revenue goals.
  • Customer Engagement
    • Serve as the first point of contact for researchers, biotech, pharma, and CRO clients seeking preclinical and translational oncology solutions.
    • Build strong, trust-based relationships by understanding client needs and recommending tailored Crown Bioscience offerings.
    • Deliver accurate and timely information regarding service capabilities, project feasibility, and proposal details.
    • Provide outstanding customer service throughout the sales cycle, ensuring client satisfaction and repeat business.
  • Operational & Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partner with operations, scientific, and project management teams to ensure feasibility, accuracy, and timely delivery of client projects.
    • Maintain detailed records of client interactions, pipeline activity, and forecasts within the CRM system.
    • Share market and customer feedback with internal stakeholders to help refine and expand service offerings.
    • Collaborate closely with external partners like Prendio to maximize lead generation opportunities and strengthen biotech outreach.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Business, or related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in inside sales, customer success, or business development in life sciences, biotechnology, or CRO sectors.
  • Strong communication, relationship-building, and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed sales targets.
  • Highly organized with attention to detail and experience using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
  • Self-motivated team player with a proactive approach and passion for supporting oncology research.

Preferred Requirements

  • Advanced degree (MSc, MBA, or equivalent) in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field.
  • 3+ years of inside sales or business development experience in oncology or precision medicine services.
  • Strong understanding of preclinical workflows (organoids, in vivo/in vitro models, biomarkers, biospecimens).
  • Experience working with or managing leads from third-party platforms (e.g., procurement networks such as Prendio).
  • Background in supporting biotech, pharma, or CRO clients with complex research needs.

Salary Range: $70,000 - $90,000

Senior Product Owner

Location: Remote

Level : Senior

We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms, real-time presence, audio / video (WebRTC), chat, screen sharing, collaborative boards, and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end-to-end (discovery → definition → delivery → post-launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. Beyond roadmap and prioritization, you will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.

What You’ll Do

  • Daily communication (English): Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders; drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow-through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership: Plan OKRs / roadmap; break initiatives into epics / stories; manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Jira & Confluence discipline (non-negotiable): Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links).
  • Create extremely well-documented tickets: clear problem statement, context, scope / out-of-scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non-functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs / screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready / Done and maintain Confluence specs / decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views / boards.
  • Discovery & definition: User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping; author PRDs / specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing: Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement: Track activation / engagement / retention, run A / B experiments, and prioritize UX / performance / stability improvements.
  • Competitor research: Benchmark features / flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.

Reporting & rituals

  • Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer:
  • What was completed today.
  • The current task and ETA for completion.
  • The next 3 tasks with planned start / end dates.
  • Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).
  • Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).
  • Mirror this view in Jira dashboards / filters with Stage / Prod target dates visible.
  • Maintain AI-generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).
  • Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.
  • Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.
  • Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code / PRs at a high level.
  • Proven follow-through: nothing falls through the cracks; you drive clarity to outcomes.
  • Tooling (required): Jira, Confluence, Figma, Slack, Google Sheets.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to WebRTC / A/V concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.
  • Certifications: CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.

title: Consultor Tecnico Comercial | Gurupi (To)
description:
Localidade : Gurupi (TO)

SUMÁRIO DA POSIÇÃO

Responsável pelas vendas a pecuaristas e técnicos do setor de trabalho e pelo aumento da penetração do portfólio Zoetis nas fazendas do painel. Promove e vende soluções e produtos Zoetis identificando e gerando necessidades nos clientes, diferenciando-se tecnicamente, prestando serviços, e construindo relacionamentos duradouros e de confiança. Trabalha em sinergia com os demais colegas do território para geração de demanda indireta e é responsável também pelo atingimento dos resultados do seu setor.

RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO

  • Responsável pelos resultados de vendas do setor no qual está alocado;
  • Gerar demanda, promover diferenciação técnica e prestar serviços aos pecuaristas e veterinários, visando aumentar a penetração do portfolio Zoetis e ser reconhecido como parceiro preferencial;
  • Identificar oportunidades comerciais, traçar planos de ação, planejar e realizar visitas às contas do painel de visitação, com base em um roteiro que permita maximizar o numero de visitas por dia de ciclo, assegurando o atendimento na frequência adequada e a cobertura do painel de visitação;
  • Implementar as estratégias / ações de marketing ligadas à geração de demanda na sua área de atuação, através da execução das atividades definidas pela área de Marketing para os ciclos promocionais;
  • Monitorar a penetração do portfolio Zoetis nas contas visitadas e definir ações específicas para melhoria do desempenho da linha nas mesmas;
  • Registrar as interações com as contas e as informações de geração de demanda (produto, demanda indireta, etc.) no Touchpoint, logo após a visita;
  • Gerir o funil de oportunidades do setor de visitação, mantendo-o atualizado e utilizando-o como base para planejamento do processo de vendas e visitação;
  • Revisar e ajustar, conforme necessário, as contas do painel de visitação, junto com o Coordenador de Demanda e a área de Marketing;
  • Prospectar e cadastrar novos clientes e manter a base de dados do TouchPoint atualizada, incluindo informações de cadastro e do rebanho;
  • Estabelecer, estreitar e gerenciar relacionamento com pecuaristas, veterinários e equipe de vendas dos principais canais do seu setor;
  • Ser o dono do relacionamento com os Médicos Veterinários GERAR do seu setor;
  • Organizar e realizar apresentações, palestras, treinamentos, dias de campo e reuniões com foco na divulgação e diferenciação da linha de produtos Zoetis e a difusão de tecnologia que o portfólio Zoetis oferece;
  • Realizar atividades de geração de demanda indireta junto ao canal (ex.: palestra, dia de campo, etc.), de acordo com o planejamento do setor;
  • Assegurar o rápido atendimento e resolução das reclamações técnicas. Responsável pelo atendimento de primeira linha dos casos de farmacovigilância;
  • Interagir e dar feedback ao Coordenador de Demanda, Consultor de Vendas e Assistente Técnico sobre as ações de Geração de Demanda, visando alinhamento no setor;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com membros da equipe técnica, comercial e de marketing, para identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos no setor;
  • Realizar / participar ativamente de todas as atividades relacionadas ao seu treinamento e capacitação técnico-comercial definidas pela unidade de negócios e / ou filial;
  • Monitorar e reportar ações da concorrência;
  • Zelar pelo bom estado dos equipamentos da área sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Zelar pela confidencialidade das informações sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Cumprir as normas e regulamentos contidos no Código de Conduta da empresa.

RELAÇÕES ORGANIZACIONAIS

Clientes (pecuaristas e médicos veterinários), Revendas, Distribuidores, colegas de Vendas e de Marketing.

RECURSOS GERENCIADOS

  • Vendas no território;
  • Gerenciar orçamento dentro da rotina de viagens no território.

EDUCAÇÃO / EXPERIÊNCIA

  • Graduação em Medicina Veterinária, Zootecnia ou Agronomia;
  • Experiência em promoção técnica e vendas de no mínimo 5 anos;
  • Inglês avançado para leitura e interpretação de material técnico (preferencial);
  • Realização de palestas e / ou treinamentos;
  • Interação com médicos veterinários, pecuaristas, professores e formadores de opinião.

REQUISITOS DE HABILIDADES TÉCNICAS

  • Habilidade para interagir e influenciar pecuaristas, médicos veterinários, especialistas, professores, formadores de opinião, etc;
  • Habilidade na comunicação oral, escrita e interpessoal (incluindo palestras, apresentações, etc.);
  • Organização, planejamento e comprovada gestão eficiente do território e do tempo. Capacidade para trabalhar de forma independente e eficiente, e em equipe;
  • Estar atualizado nas informações técnicas e cientificas, bem como pró-atividade na busca por atualizações técnica (própria e dos demais colegas da equipe);
  • Domínio no pacote MS-Office.

REQUISITOS DA POSIÇÃO – ESPAÇO FISICO

Disponibilidade para viagens e grande contato com clientes de sua unidade de negócios.

Full time

A Rox Partner é uma empresa jovem, focada em dados, em rápido crescimento como consultoria. Com quase 6 anos anos no mercado já contamos com mais de 160 colaboradores, ótimos clientes, parceiros e inúmeros desafios! E aí, bora evoluir juntos?

Estamos em plena expansão e buscamos profissionais motivados que anseiem integrar-se a uma empolgante jornada rumo à excelência em dados. Esta é uma vaga de Senior Analytics Engineer – DBT Core.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Atuar como referência técnica em projetos de engenharia de dados e BI / Analytics, liderando iniciativas de modelagem, transformação e disponibilização de dados.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir pipelines de dados utilizando DBT Core, assegurando boas práticas no uso de macros, templates, tagueamentos e catálogo de dados.
  • Conduzir a orquestração ponta a ponta dos fluxos de dados, desde a ingestão até a camada analítica, garantindo performance, governança e confiabilidade.
  • Apoiar as áreas de negócio no desenho de soluções analíticas, traduzindo necessidades em modelos de dados eficientes.
  • Atuar na análise de processos AS-IS e propor refatorações e melhorias contínuas em integrações e pipelines existentes.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, promovendo alinhamento entre engenharia, analytics e negócio.
  • Elaborar documentação técnica e boas práticas para sustentar e escalar o ambiente de dados.

COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS

  • Experiência avançada em DBT Core, incluindo uso de macros e templates, aplicação de tagueamentos, criação de documentação e catálogo de dados.
  • Experiência prática em Google Cloud Platform (GCP), com domínio em BigQuery, estruturas de dados, modelagem relacional e analítica, além de otimização de queries (SQL tuning).
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação, especialmente Python, para automações, desenvolvimento de scripts de integração e suporte a pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência em bancos de dados, com ênfase em Oracle, incluindo leitura e análise de processos legados.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de ETL / ELT de mercado, preferencialmente Informatica Power Center, para entendimento, manutenção e refatoração de fluxos existentes.
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de dados, incluindo versionamento de código com Git, implementação de testes automatizados, aplicação de práticas de governança e monitoramento de pipelines.

BENEFÍCIOS OFERECIDOS

  • Contrato PJ;
  • Atuação remota;
  • Vale Home Office (VR / VA) no valor de R$ 300 por mês cumulativos para gastar como, quando e onde quiser (o valor é creditado na sua conta do iFood mensalmente e temos o cartão bandeira elo);

title: Medical Specialist
description:
Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we are helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

Overview

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

title: Enfermeiro Generalista - Centro Obstétrico - Maternidademaria Amélia Buarque De Hollanda
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04 / 03 / 1966, 40.103 de 17 / 05 / 1962 e 8.911, de 30 / 07 / 1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética
  • Possuir Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.
  • Possuir Pós graduação - especialização completa em Obstetria
  • Possuir Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Possuir experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Enfermeiro em Maternidade
  • Possuir fácil acesso ao Centro do Rio
  • Possuir disponibilidade total para atuar em formato de plantão 12x60 (plantão a ser definido)
  • Organizar a operacionalização do serviço de Enfermagem e garantir o bom andamento dos serviços; realizar orientações aos pacientes; manter controle de salas equipamentos e leitos disponíveis; orientar o trabalho da equipe de técnicos;
  • Atender as normativas do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN);
  • Garantir o cumprimento das rotinas, normas e protocolos institucionais e de SMS;
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao usuário, desde a sua admissão, e acompanhar o atendimento técnico;
  • Atuar como facilitador de todos os processos que envolvem o atendimento de enfermagem;
  • Promover, juntamente ao gestor, ambiente que proporcione melhorias contínuas no processo assistencial;
  • Manter a comunicação com o corpo clínico, referente a mudanças no fluxo da Assistência de Enfermagem (quando interferir em processo médico);
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem segura, humanizada e individualizada aos pacientes;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas e recomendações estabelecidas junto aos serviços de saúde colaborando para o controle de infecção;
  • Ministrar treinamentos quando necessário promovendo atualização contínua à equipe de enfermagem;
  • Auxiliar o gestor no controle de certificação profissional da equipe de enfermagem junto ao conselho de classe, assim como executar o processo de comunicação junto órgão;
  • Conduzir a gestão das notificações de não conformidades de avaliação de eficácia, referentes à Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Gerir o controle de entrada e saída de materiais estocados no setor, mantendo o estoque mínimo necessário para o desenvolvimento da Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Preencher e supervisionar o preenchimento dos registros específicos da Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Assegurar a correta utilização dos equipamentos e acessórios disponíveis para o processo assistencial;
  • Prestar assistência a pacientes graves, desde a admissão, e acompanhá-los em caso de remoção á outro serviço;
  • Organizar processo de armazenamento de receituários controlados;
  • Organizar e controlar processo de esterilização de materiais;
  • Supervisionar ou acompanhar a realização de procedimentos assistenciais, enfocando segurança e diminuição de riscos de infecção;
  • Acompanhar a eficácia da escala de serviços da equipe de enfermagem;
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir normas e recomendações de Biossegurança, mantendo o ambiente seguro para o paciente e equipe multiprofissional;
  • Participar das ações de parceria entre a unidade de saúde e as instituições de ensino, considerando a indissociabilidade da relação entre ensino e serviço, apoiando o desenvolvimento de campos de estágio, pesquisa e / ou residência no seu setor de trabalho;
  • Apoiar e propiciar condições para aquisição de conhecimentos no campo profissional de estagiários e / ou residentes nas atividades assistenciais sob sua responsabilidade, quando solicitado e conforme avaliação junto ao gestor imediato;
  • Observar o cumprimento dos aspectos éticos envolvidos na assistência ao usuário, quando os espaços de atendimento e a realização de procedimentos envolva a participação de estagiários, pesquisadores e / ou residentes;
  • Participar das oportunidades de formação e desenvolvimento ofertadas como contrapartida pelas instituições de ensino.
  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD.
  • Realizar as atividades de área / setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Senior Product Owner

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end-to-end (discovery → definition → delivery → post-launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. Beyond roadmap and prioritization, you will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.

What You’ll Do

  • Daily communication (English): Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders; drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow-through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership: Plan OKRs / roadmap; break initiatives into epics / stories; manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Jira & Confluence discipline (non-negotiable):
  • Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links).
  • Create extremely well-documented tickets: clear problem statement, context, scope / out-of-scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non-functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs / screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready / Done and maintain Confluence specs / decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views / boards.
  • Discovery & definition: User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping; author PRDs / specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing: Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement: Track activation / engagement / retention, run A / B experiments, and prioritize UX / performance / stability improvements.
  • Competitor research: Benchmark features / flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.

Reporting & Rituals

  • Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer:
    • What was completed today.
    • The current task and ETA for completion.
    • The next 3 tasks with planned start / end dates.
    • Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).
    • Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).
  • Mirror this view in Jira dashboards / filters with Stage / Prod target dates visible.
  • Maintain AI-generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).
  • Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.
  • Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.
  • Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code / PRs at a high level.
  • Proven follow-through: nothing falls through the cracks; you drive clarity to outcomes.
  • Tooling (required): Jira, Confluence, Figma, Slack, Google Sheets.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to WebRTC / A / V concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.
  • Certifications: CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Senior Product Owner

Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (full-time)

Level : Senior

We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms, real-time presence, audio / video (WebRTC), chat, screen sharing, collaborative boards, and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end-to-end (discovery → definition → delivery → post-launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. Beyond roadmap and prioritization, you will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.

What You’ll Do

  • Daily communication (English): Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders; drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow-through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership: Plan OKRs / roadmap; break initiatives into epics / stories; manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Jira & Confluence discipline (non-negotiable):
  • Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links).
  • Create extremely well-documented tickets: clear problem statement, context, scope / out-of-scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non-functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs / screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready / Done and maintain Confluence specs / decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views / boards.
  • Discovery & definition: User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping; author PRDs / specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing: Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement: Track activation / engagement / retention, run A / B experiments, and prioritize UX / performance / stability improvements.
  • Competitor research: Benchmark features / flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.

Reporting & rituals

  • Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer:
  • What was completed today.
  • The current task and ETA for completion.
  • The next 3 tasks with planned start / end dates.
  • Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).
  • Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).
  • Mirror this view in Jira dashboards / filters with Stage / Prod target dates visible.
  • Maintain AI-generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).
  • Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.
  • Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.
  • Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code / PRs at a high level.
  • Proven follow-through: nothing falls through the cracks; you drive clarity to outcomes.
  • Tooling (required): Jira, Confluence, Figma, Slack, Google Sheets.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to WebRTC / A / V concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.
  • Certifications: CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.

Overview

description:
Overview

We’re looking for a Mobile Analytics & Attribution Specialist to help us deliver clean, reliable data and performance insights across mobile apps. This role is ideal for someone who understands the complexity of mobile tracking, SDKs, MMPs, app store ecosystems, and knows how to connect the dots so marketing teams can see exactly which channels drive installs, engagement, and revenue.

If you enjoy solving attribution puzzles across iOS, Android, and paid channels, this role will put you at the center of impactful client work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement, audit, and optimize mobile analytics setups using tools like Firebase, Adjust, Appsflyer, or Branch.

  • Align app tracking setups with paid campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, and other platforms.
  • Support integration of SKAdNetwork (SKAN) for iOS campaigns and ensure data quality.
  • Identify and resolve attribution discrepancies across platforms and reporting systems.
  • Build dashboards (Looker Studio, BigQuery, or other BI tools) to visualize mobile performance clearly.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years of hands-on experience with mobile analytics tools (Firebase, Adjust, Appsflyer, or Branch).
  • Strong understanding of mobile attribution models and post-install event tracking.
  • Familiarity with iOS and Android tracking limitations, including ATT and SKAdNetwork.
  • Experience working with paid acquisition tracking for mobile apps.
  • Ability to troubleshoot SDK integrations, misfiring events, or discrepancies in MMP data.
  • Clear communication skills to bridge technical insights with marketing needs.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with server-to-server (S2S) integrations and APIs for advanced attribution.
  • Knowledge of privacy-first tracking approaches and consent frameworks.
  • Exposure to funnel reporting and cohort analysis for mobile growth.

title: Tech Lead - Rio De Janeiro/Rj
description:
Overview

Como a maior empresa de Educação Básica do Brasil, nos cercamos de pessoas excepcionais, entusiasmadas e comprometidas com a missão de transformar vidas e o Brasil por meio da educação.

Buscamos ser a referência no mundo em tecnologia para educação! Para isso, procuramos pessoas antenadas e apaixonadas por desenvolvimento de software, ávidas por conhecimento, que gostem de inovar, e que sejam proativas e criativas na busca das melhores soluções para nossas escolas, alunos, professores e funcionários.

Na função de Tech Lead de uma de nossas Squads, esperamos que você possua uma forte bagagem técnica e perfil colaborativo, capaz de treinar e liderar, influenciar decisões técnicas e de negócio, e contribuir ativamente para o desenvolvimento profissional do time.

Valorizamos quem alia excelência técnica a uma escuta ativa e visão estratégica.

Responsibilities and Assignments

Sua missão será :

  • Liderar o time técnico – Desenvolvedores, QAs e Suporte Técnico – de uma Squad, garantindo uma cultura de excelência de entrega em termos de prazos e qualidade;
  • Atuar com maestria em todo ciclo de vida de um projeto de software: entendimento das necessidades de negócio, refinamentos técnicos, definição de arquitetura, delivery, testes automatizados, integração contínua, deploy contínuo;
  • Conduzir a definição e evolução do roadmap & débitos técnicos da equipe;
  • Trabalhar com a equipe de Produto e Design para entender as necessidades do negócio, antecipando as mudanças para proporcionar uma experiência incrível ao usuário, garantindo assim a entrega de sistemas intuitivos, bonitos e com ótima usabilidade;
  • Conduzir revisões de código, promover a evolução contínua da arquitetura e garantir a manutenção de padrões organizacionais;
  • Participar ativamente de rituais, workshops, reuniões de alinhamento e momentos de formação técnica com o time;
  • Ser um agente de cultura e desenvolvimento, promovendo autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e colaboração;
  • Ser um agente no uso de IA em todas as funções da equipe;
  • Transmitir seus conhecimentos para o time de forma constante, contribuindo para o crescimento técnico de toda equipe.

Requirements and Qualifications

Para assumir esse desafio, você precisa ter :

  • Experiência de no mínimo 3 anos liderando times de desenvolvimento;
  • Que seja uma yes-person, sempre encarando os desafios com otimismo;
  • Que seja incansável na busca da alta performance da equipe, tanto em termos de compromissos / prazos quanto em termos de qualidade de excelência;
  • Vasta experiência em desenvolvimento, especificamente com HTML / CSS / Javascript, .NET, Angular.
  • Domínio das melhores práticas em qualidade de desenvolvimento, especificamente Design Patterns, S.O.L.I.D e Testes Unitários / API / Automatizados;
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e não relacionais, performance e estratégias de uso;
  • Experiência com DevOps, Continuous Delivery Pipeline (CI, CD, Containers, Dynamic Environment Configuration);
  • Experiência no uso de alguma ferramenta de IA (ex. Cursor, Github Copilot).

Além disso, será considerado como diferencial :

  • Experiência com observabilidade (ex. Datadog, CloudWatch, Kibana, etc);
  • Terraform / Docker;
  • Já tenha trabalhado com nuvens públicas (AWS, Azure, etc.);
  • Experiência com Microserviços.

E esperamos que você coloque em prática algumas características :

  • Seja antenado e apaixonado por desenvolvimento de software;
  • Seja Ávido por conhecimento;
  • Tenha proatividade;
  • Trabalhe bem equipe, que goste de aprender, ensinar e ajudar o time;
  • Seja cuidadoso com excelência e qualidade;
  • Seja resiliente.

Additional Information

Carga horária : 44 horas semanais.

Localidade: a empresa é em Botafogo - Rio de Janeiro (RJ), mas o trabalho é 100% remoto.

Nós oferecemos : Vale-Refeição; Vale-Transporte; Trabalho Remoto; Auxílio Home Office; Direito a receber um reembolso de até R$400,00 referente à compra de uma cadeira ergonômica, visando beneficiar o trabalho remoto; Assistência médica e odontológica SulAmérica (com co-participação); Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR); Day off no mês do aniversário; Ambiente Salta de Aprendizagem : Cursos gratuitos sobre liderança e comunicação que vão alavancar sua carreira!; Parcerias no Salta +Benefícios : T.T Burguer, Chefs Club, PrimePass, Magalu, NetShoes, Ponto Frio, Casas Bahia, Cultura Inglesa, CNA, Ibmec, Le Canton, BodyTech, Budda Spa, entre vários outros!; Seu filho(a) tem direito a bolsa escolar (consulte a equipe de Gente e Gestão para verificar as regras).

Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e, por isso, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas que se identifiquem com grupos minorizados em todas as nossas posições.

Fique tranquilo (a) ao cadastrar seus dados na vaga. O Grupo Salta segue a LGPD – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (Lei Federal 13.709 / 2018), que entrou em vigor em agosto de 2020, logo, garantimos responsabilidade ao utilizar seus dados somente em nosso processo seletivo, para fins de cadastro e controle de candidatos.

CONHEÇA O GRUPO SALTA EDUCAÇÃO

Somos o maior grupo de educação básica do Brasil e temos a missão de construir um país melhor para as próximas gerações. Quer saber como fazemos isso?

Acreditamos que o ensino de qualidade pode ser um modelo sustentável para impactar crianças e jovens em todo o país. E esse desafio nos move diariamente.

Para realizar esse sonho, contamos com um time inovador e criativo, cheio de energia e, principalmente, apaixonado pelo que faz. O nosso DNA é marcado pela cultura de excelência, impacto social, desenvolvimento pessoal e espírito realizador.

Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e, por isso, visamos a contratar talentos em igualdade de oportunidades. Também levamos a inclusão a sério, pensando em processos de reconhecimento justos e éticos, além de contarmos com grupos de afinidade racial, LGBTQIA+, de pessoas com deficiência e de gênero.

Se você quer ser impulsionado para impulsionar, o Grupo Salta é o seu lugar. Venha construir um legado de transformação conosco!

Job Description Summary

The Training Operations Specialist owns a segment of the customer technical training portfolio focused on Life Care Solutions which include anesthesia & respiratory care, diagnostic cardiology, and maternal infant care technical service training and may include Diagnostic Imaging modalities, as well.

This role is responsible for aligning training entitlements to specific course offerings meeting customer training needs. The role is expected to work across an extended team which includes US and Canada Sales, Service, Finance, Student Services and GE Healthcare's College of Life Care Solutions.

This role is remote.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • This individual is responsible for acting as a subject matter expert in their area(s) of ownership, enabling the training organizations to focus on the customers and team.

  • Ability to independently solve problems with significant degree of complexity.
  • Maintain and respond with urgency to all incoming requests of applications operations for field assistance including, but not limited to, application tool support, quoting, availability of training days, and relevant metrics and data.
  • Drive improvements in customer experience through efficient and effective operations and customer communications processes.
  • Support onboarding and offboarding of applications resources, including access and assets, and maintenance of overall clinical applications team reference.
  • Enable daily operations of applications and technical training organizations, readily catching and owning tasks that prevent focus on the customer and clinical applications specialists, including scheduling of resources, extension of training expirations, cancellations, financial inquiries, and MCT (My Customer Training) guidance.

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, GED, or local equivalent with minimum 2 years of Operations/Customer Service experience.
  • Strong, demonstrated knowledge of current computer/office communications technologies with expertise in PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook, Saleforce, OneNote.
  • Demonstrated self-starter, self-directed, team-oriented individual who thrives in a fast paced, dynamic business environment with effective time management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Ability to energize, develop, and build rapport. Act with optimism, humility, and hustle.
  • Potential Overnight Travel up to four weeks a year.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership - always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities.
